fields.description:
# BA-2: Contact & Payment Fields

_BA's contact and payment-adjacent fields — trimmed down from the prototype's fuller contact section._

### FIELDS

* Primary Email — also used for login
* Phone
* E-Transfer Email
* Payment Currency
* Notes — Long text, general-purpose

* Renamed from Payment Notes — Joyce Kiddell, [1:02:18](https://fathom.video/calls/787411922?timestamp=3738): "this can be just like general notes, not payment notes."

### IMPLEMENTATION REQUIREMENTS

* Preferred Contact Method, Payment Method, and Payment Frequency all removed

* Lina Ceniccola, [1:00:12](https://fathom.video/calls/787411922?timestamp=3612): "I would take out all three of them. So preferred contact, payment method, payment frequency, because like we'll track that stuff in our payroll anyway."

* No separate Login Email field

* Kobi Kunasekaran, [1:02:30](https://fathom.video/calls/787411922?timestamp=3750): "would there be a case where the primary email was different from their login email? Shouldn't. Shouldn't, right?"

### NOTES

* Provenance: BA-2 (Brand Ambassador Record User Stories doc).
* Open question carried from the doc: now that Payment Method is cut, what triggers E-Transfer Email being required (it was previously conditional on Payment Method = E-Transfer)? Not confirmed.

### SOURCE

* [Taryn doc BA-2 — Brand Ambassador Record User Stories](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1MsJXwt3oY-DyQuAdMzNYlyPenKUQl7g8mHzMmeRaVHs/edit?tab=t.g64hrhse8pog)
* [Aug 18 Weekly Sync — Joyce Kiddell, 1:02:18 (Notes rename)](https://fathom.video/calls/787411922?timestamp=3738)
* [Aug 18 Weekly Sync — Lina Ceniccola, 1:00:12 (fields removed)](https://fathom.video/calls/787411922?timestamp=3612)
* [Aug 18 Weekly Sync — Kobi Kunasekaran, 1:02:30 (no login email field)](https://fathom.video/calls/787411922?timestamp=3750)
* Dependencies: [BUILD-202 — Brand Ambassador: Object + Core Status](https://app.asana.com/0/0/1217693577680227/f/)
* Owner (proposed): Taryn Reithofer
* Created 2026-08-20 from Brand Ambassador record documentation review.
